I, Gayantha Karunatilleke, Minister of Lands and ParliamentaryReforms, hereby declare, under Sub-section (1) of Section 5 of theLand Acquisition Act, that the land described below is needed for apublic purpose and will be acquired under the provisions of that Act.

Boundaries for the allotment of land containing in extent as belowand depicted in the Advance Tracing No. R/KRE/2017/683 dated24.10.2017 prepared by the Senior Superintendant of Survey for thevillage called Matuwagala, in the Uda Pattu North Minor Division ofKuruwiti Korale in the Divisional Secretariat Division of Kiriella inRatnapura District in Sabaragamuwa Province:

A. S. PrasannaGunasekara, K. G. Indra Kumara, Arthur Thalgahagoda and A. G.Nandasena and Matuwagala Estate belongs to the State; South:

Matuwagala Estate belongs to the State, Maldenige watta possessedby Bamunuge Don Dhanawardhana and Diyaneththe Kumburapossessed by Kandaboda Gamaethiralalage Jayaratne; West:Diyaneththe Kumbura possessed by Kandaboda GamaethiralalageJayaratne, Diyaneththe dola, Matuwagala watta possessed byJayasinghe Arachchige Wimaladasa, Kanagenigedeniye yaya,Kahambiliya henyaya, Nawala henyaya, Kokile hena ad MatuwagalaEstate belongs to Balangoda Plantaions.
